resources.string: CurSimple is a timetable and reminder tool that runs entirely on your device.
Your timetable comes from what you import or from plugins you authorize; nothing is uploaded to any server.

Class reminders rely on exact alarms and notifications, which battery optimization, Do Not Disturb, or a manufacturer\'s background limits can affect. The author is not liable for any lateness, missed classes, or other loss this may cause.

The built-in data follows the State Council\'s annual holiday notice and covers each full break, shifted days included. Make-up workdays from that notice are not included; add them here by hand, and manual entries take priority over the built-in data. If a make-up workday should follow another weekday\'s timetable, add a temporary change as well.

Silencing only changes the ringer mode or the Do Not Disturb level. Class reminders use the alarm audio channel, so they are not affected. Do Not Disturb is only set to priority only, never to total silence. Classes cancelled by a holiday or a temporary change do not trigger silencing, and back-to-back classes are not switched over and over. When class ends, the state from before class is restored; if you changed the ringer yourself during class, the app leaves your choice alone.
